Her work at MPPS Girls Gandhari helped increase enrolment from around 40 to 130 students, while her 1,336 teaching videos crossed 57 crore views. From play-based learning and digital pedagogy to community outreach and coaching rural students, Bhavani’s journey reflects how teachers are expanding their role beyond classrooms. The article also profiles the other educators recognised nationally for transforming school education.

Despite the attention, the property has not found a buyer. Its price was first cut to $4.85 million and has now fallen to $3.995 million. The current asking price is still far above Cherry Grove’s record sale of $2.7 million.

Acquired eleven years ago for a mere fourteen point five million, this one hundred four-acre island boasts a private golf course and twenty-nine potential residential plots. As the founder of It Works!, Pentecost has skillfully developed this paradise into both a business and family haven, offering unparalleled fishing and coastal access near Boca Grande.

title: 'Win against India damaged us a lot': Yousuf explains Pakistan cricket's decline
description: Pakistan had never beaten India in a World Cup before that match in 2021. Babar Azam scored an unbeaten 68, while Mohammad Rizwan made 79 not out as Pakistan chased down 152 without losing a wicket. The win was celebrated as a historic moment for Pakistan cricket. However, Yousuf believes the victory also changed the mindset of the players and played a role in the team's decline in the years that followed.

title: The Yamuna is rising again: How prepared is Delhi for another flood?
description: Delhi is under the shadow of recurrent flooding threats as the Yamuna River inches closer to its danger threshold. The catastrophic floods from the previous year resulted in the displacement of thousands and interrupted vital public services. Fortunately, this year has seen reduced upstream water releases, offering a brief respite; however, the risk of heavy rainfall above could still ignite a serious crisis.

description: The housing market in New Zealand has experienced its most significant decline in over three years, driven by factors such as elevated interest rates and a shaky economy. Since early 2022, home values have continuously dropped, with the Reserve Bank predicting further falls before any signs of recovery. Experts suggest that a rebound in the market hinges on improvements in the labor sector.

title: What does the law say about inheritance? Know your rights
Women's rights pioneer Lisle Lester's ashes return home after 138 years
description: Lisle Lester, a journalist, publisher, actress and women’s-rights advocate from Fond du Lac, died penniless in New York in 1888 at age 50. Her cremated remains remained unclaimed for 138 years. After efforts by local women and the Fond du Lac Soroptimists, her remains have now returned home for burial.

title: How Kentucky protected a vast elk landscape
description: Kentucky hunters faced uncertainty with temporary land access agreements. A new conservation partnership secured permanent public access to a large elk hunting area. This agreement provides 54,560 acres for public use in eastern Kentucky. The project involved state officials, conservation groups, and federal funding programs. This ensures continued hunting traditions and habitat restoration for future generations.

The bus was used by Kesey and his Merry Band of Pranksters during their 1964 cross-country journey, which helped spread the emerging psychedelic counterculture. The exhibition also features Jerry Garcia’s BMW and will launch an effort to restore the now-dilapidated bus.

title: ‘Regulates food safety, not festivals’: FDA chief Tukaram Mundhe clarifies new order

It ensures food served at gatherings is safe and compliant with existing laws.  The directive establishes a year-round framework for consistent implementation.  This aims to prevent illness while allowing celebrations to continue.

The recent positive employment statistics in the US have heightened speculation regarding the Fed's stance in September.

It also incorporates hybrid-electric propulsion for reduced signatures.  The tank is designed for networked battlefield operations and deep assaults.  This new platform signals a significant shift in China's armored warfare approach.

title: Can US really make Hormuz safe? The dangerous battle against Iran’s sea mines
Why some people constantly check their phones even when they are not bored
description: Smartphones bring us immediate engagement, filling the gaps of silence and curtailing our tendency to reflect. This urge to stay connected often arises from our discomfort with unplanned time and our inner dialogues. Studies indicate this behavior correlates with a heightened susceptibility to boredom and a yearning for connections. The feeling of loneliness and learned patterns also heavily influence our habitual phone usage.

The Ganga has surpassed its former record flood level at Gandhi Ghat, leading authorities to raise alerts for downstream localities and boost relief activities. Several other rivers are similarly exceeding danger levels, and with rain predictions suggesting additional water rises, the outlook remains concerning.

title: Max Verstappen's Monza story: From fastest lap in F1 history to P5 start at 2026
description: In an explosive display of speed, Max Verstappen shattered two Formula 1 records at Monza in 2025. With an average of 264.682 km/h, he clocked the fastest qualifying lap in history, while the 2025 Italian Grand Prix itself marked a record for the quickest race ever. Despite this success, Verstappen's performance saw him qualifying fifth for the upcoming 2026 Italian Grand Prix.

title: Handshake goes wrong: Magnus Carlsen and Vachier-Lagrave share hilarious moment

The Norwegian returned to the Global Chess League (GCL) after missing last year's edition in Mumbai. Representing defending champions Alpine APL Pipers, Carlsen was held to a draw by Maxime Vachier-Lagrave of Cheq Mumba Masters.

title: In 2020, CalGuard crews rescued 242 people trapped by California's Creek Fire
description: California National Guard crews performed a historic nighttime helicopter rescue during the Creek Fire.  They saved 242 people trapped by intense flames and thick smoke.  This extraordinary mission utilized night-vision goggles and combat helicopters in a wildfire zone.  The daring rescue demonstrated new possibilities for nighttime wildfire aviation response.  California has since expanded its nighttime aviation capabilities and interagency training.

title: 'Save us, save us': Children trapped under Delhi rubble as rescue ops continue
description: A building collapsed near Shiv Mandir in Delhi's Satya Niketan area on Sunday afternoon.  Children were heard crying for help from beneath the extensive rubble after the incident.  Rescue teams arrived promptly and began extensive search operations for those trapped inside.  Several people, including children and fruit vendors, are feared buried under the debris.  Rescue efforts are continuing as emergency personnel work to locate survivors.

Despite the efforts of bystanders to change her mind, she proceeded with the drastic act. A combined rescue mission was initiated, but she has yet to be located, leaving her motives shrouded in uncertainty.

title: In 2024, Pennsylvania couple bought 101 acres; by 2026 all were protected
description: In 2024, Jeff and Betsy Yingling bought 101 acres in Freedom Township, Adams County, Pennsylvania, and soon began considering how to protect the land permanently. After living there and seeing its wildlife, cropland, wooded areas and changing scenery, they decided to place a preservation easement on the property. The easement was finalised in August 2026, permanently protecting all 101 acres for future generations.

Sentenced to fifteen years in prison and required to make restitution, he managed to evade authorities post-arrest in Mexico by escaping to Germany. The FBI is now urgently seeking tips that could lead to his recapture and subsequent conviction.

The anticipated foldable iPhone Ultra could exceed two thousand US dollars, while standard iPhone 18 Pro models might witness minor price hikes. Given currency fluctuations, retail prices in India are expected to be steeper, positioning the foldable iPhone ahead of competitors such as Google and Samsung.

Bhardwaj faces charges for an alleged attack on the activist's father during protests. NSUI president Vinod Jakhar visited the family and questioned police inaction. title: Extra CO2 boosted Wisconsin forest productivity 39%, but ozone cut the gain
description: A Wisconsin experiment studied forest communities exposed to high carbon dioxide and ozone. Elevated carbon dioxide significantly increased forest productivity and carbon storage over eleven years. Conversely, increased ozone levels reduced forest productivity and ecosystem carbon content. The combined effects showed carbon dioxide stimulating growth and ozone limiting it. These findings highlight forests' complex responses to atmospheric changes.

title: Iran planning 'multi-front' attack on Israel with Hezbollah, Hamas, Houthis: Report

description: MacKenzie Scott has now donated over one billion dollars to historically Black colleges. Her recent forty-two million dollar gift to Elizabeth City State University marked this milestone. Scott has provided significant funding to numerous institutions since 2020. These unrestricted donations empower universities to allocate funds as needed. Her extensive philanthropic efforts support various educational and community initiatives.
